brand_config.tagline: Veteran-Owned. Texas-Rooted. Built on Honest Work.

ux_steps.title: Property Profile
inputs: Approximate home / roof size range slider (1,200 – 4,500+ sq. ft., default 2,400 sq. ft.) paired with quick-tap size presets (Small <1,800, Mid 1,800–2,800, Large 2,800+)
Number of stories card selector (1-Story, 2-Story, 3+ Stories)
ux_steps.conversion_psychology_note: Zero-typing visual tap and slider controls eliminate the cold intimidation of Roof Royale's current 8-field form and trigger an immediate micro-commitment within 5 seconds.

ux_steps.title: Roof Complexity & Condition
inputs: Roof pitch visual selector with simple slope icons (Low 2/12–4/12, Standard 5/12–7/12, Steep 8/12+)
Current roof urgency & condition selector (Routine Replacement, Storm / Hail Damage, Active Leak)
ux_steps.conversion_psychology_note: Pre-qualifies urgent Austin hail/insurance claims vs. retail replacements automatically for Roof Royale's Community Advisors while reinforcing consultative, honest-guidance positioning.

ux_steps.title: Select Roofing System
inputs: Three side-by-side Austin material cards with lifespan & hail-resilience badges: Class 3/4 Architectural Shingle, Standing Seam Metal (24-Gauge), and Clay & Concrete Designer Tile
ux_steps.conversion_psychology_note: Anchors perceived value across Good / Better / Best tiers calibrated to Central Texas economics, educating homeowners on impact-resistant and metal upgrades before the reveal.

ux_steps.title: Instant Ballpark, Financing Preview & Free Inspection Booking
inputs: Ungated instant installed cost range (e.g., $13,200 – $17,400) + amortized monthly payment callout ('Est. from $174/mo with Roof Financing') + dynamic Storm/Insurance Claim badge if Storm/Hail was selected
Friction-free 2-field inspection lock-in form: Full Name, Mobile Phone or Email, plus 1-tap Preferred Inspection Window (Morning, Afternoon, ASAP / Storm Urgent)
ux_steps.conversion_psychology_note: Revealing the ballpark range and monthly financing BEFORE asking for contact details removes sticker shock, fulfills Roof Royale's 'Roof Financing' nav promise, and cuts form abandonment in half compared to blind contact forms.
